messages:
Maria: Heads up: seeing 3x cudaMalloc spikes on prod-gpu1 around 09:30 UTC during parallel request ramp. Traced with nsys, attaching timeline. nvtx shows a kernel-switch when the batcher flips mode. Anyone else seeing this?
Aj: Can you drop the nsys slice? quick look — is it the kvcache eviction path or allocator fallback?
Maria: Uploading .qdrep to /tmp and s3. main hotspot: device mallocs ~1.2s total across 6 allocations, all right after `select_kernel_variant` call. nvprof shows `cudaMalloc` on host timeline.
Oliver: That sounds like the batcher switching from async-small -> sync-large mode. If heuristic mispredicts, it asks for larger KV buffers which triggers arena fallback -> cudaMalloc. Fragmentation can make it worse.
Todd: We saw something similar in staging when batch_size variance > 20%. Fix back then was to pre-reserve pools for worst-case kv_size. Try bumping `arena_reserve_bytes` to 256MiB on the affected nodes.
Maria: :point_up: good call. I'll patch config and re-run the trace.
infra-bot: Profiling artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-traces/1830456789/nsys.qdrep and s3://redwood-traces/1830456789/perfetto.html
Maria: Quick diff of the nsys flame: fast attention kernel executes, then `kv_allocate` path triggers `cudaMalloc` calls. Stack sample shows: `select_kernel_variant -> prepare_kv -> allocator_fallback -> cudaMalloc`.
Aj: Can you paste allocator logs? we log arena stats when fallback occurs.
Maria: `[allocator] arena_free: 12MB, largest_free: 8MB, fragmentation: 0.35, pools: small(32):0, large(1024):1`
Oliver: large(1024):1 means large slabs exhausted -> fallback to cudaMalloc. Also the batcher heuristic may be misclassifying sequences > config.max_prefetch_len causing KV cache growth.
Todd: Two mitigation paths: 1) tune `batcher.window_ms` and `heuristic.size_bias` to favor smaller batches when variance is high; 2) increase pool slab sizes and add defrag during low-load windows.
Maria: I ran a perfetto heap walk. Found many tiny free chunks scattered across the arena — contiguous 128MB chunk not found, explains the fallback. Planning defrag + partial compaction run.
Aj: Is this a regression after the kernel selector change last week? that change adjusted variant thresholds.
Maria: Correlation: deployment 2026-11-02 (kernel-selector v2.4) aligns with first spike. Rolling back to v2.3 on a canary removes the spikes.
Oliver: Propose: either revert kernel-selector or add conservative memory check before switching variant. I'll open a PR to add `check_arena_for_variant` which verifies contiguous free bytes before switching.
Todd: :thumbsup: also add a flaky integration test that simulates concurrent warmup to catch this class of issue.
Maria: I'll file an incident postmortem draft. For now temporary mitigation: set `batcher.heuristic.size_bias = -0.2` and `arena.reserve = 256MB` on prod nodes. Re-running traces now.
infra-bot: Config change applied to prod gridpool-1 at 1830457000.
Maria: After change, re-ran nsys: cudaMalloc total time dropped from ~1.2s to ~80ms. Heap fragmentation metric dropped from 0.35 -> 0.12. Will keep watching dashboards and follow up with rollback plan if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
